findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed carrots stored below raw fish in the prep cooler. CORRECTED- carrots were voluntarily discarded by the person in charge (PIC). Ensure ready to eat food are always stored ABOVE raw foods to prevent cross contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food. [P]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: PIC began to don gloves after handling a cellphone without washing hands first. CORRECTED- Inspector interrupted the behavior and reminded PIC to wash hands, which they did, then donned gloves to continue work. Ensure employees wash hands after any task that may have contaminated them and before donning gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink was observed blocked by a roll of plastic wrap upon inspector’s arrival. CORRECTED- PIC moved the plastic wrap so the handsink is accessible. Keep handsinks clear and accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. [Pf]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: There is no ambient thermometer present inside of the bottom of the prep cooler. Ensure thermometers are provided inside all cold holding units (in addition to any digital thermometers that may be built in to the units).
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Approved thawing methods used
findings.comment: A sealed package of ROP tuna was observed thawed in the bottom of the sushi prep cooler. The package had written instructions to remove from packaging before thawing. Upon request, PIC cut the package and removed the thawed fish. Ensure ROP fish is thawed according to the supplier’s instructions.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.13 (E) ROP FISH that bear label shall be removed from packaging before thawing under refrigeration, upon completion of thawing from running water. [C]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
No ambient thermometer was present inside of the bottom of the prep cooler. Ensure thermometers are provided inside all cold holding units (in addition to any digital thermometers that may be built in to the units).
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. [C]

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
One of the two employees present has not completed food handler training. Ensure all employees who handle food or wash dishes complete food handler training within 30 days of hire. Keep food handler certificates on file for review during inspections.
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement. [C]

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee began to don gloves after handling their phone without washing hands first. CORRECTED- Inspector interrupted the employee, who then washed hands and donned gloves. Wash hands before donning gloves and after any activity that may have contaminated hands.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  [P]
